focus.title: 本周全球经贸主线：出口管制联动收紧、关税工具化加速与供应链合规重构
focus.summary: 本周国际经贸法律环境呈现三条主线：一是美欧在半导体、先进计算与关键矿产领域持续收紧出口管制与投资审查，并强化对第三国转口的穿透式监管；二是关税工具进一步政治化，多国以反倾销、反补贴及“对等关税”调查作为谈判筹码，贸易救济案件数量上升；三是供应链合规从“原产地管理”转向“全链条尽职调查”，跨国客户要求中国供应商提供更完整的管制物项与制裁筛查证明。对出海企业而言，合规成本前置、合同条款重构与多法域申报协调成为本周最突出的经营变量。
focus.source: 来源：综合WTO、美国BIS、欧盟委员会及主要律所贸易合规观察 · 本周
focus.title_en: This Week's Global Trade Law Mainlines: Tightening Export Controls, Weaponised Tariffs and Supply-Chain Compliance Restructuring
focus.summary_en: This week's international trade law landscape was defined by three mainlines. First, the US and EU continued to tighten export controls and investment screening in semiconductors, advanced computing and critical minerals, with enhanced extraterritorial scrutiny of third-country transshipment. Second, tariff instruments became further politicised, with anti-dumping, countervailing and so-called reciprocal tariff investigations used as negotiating leverage, driving up trade-remedy cases. Third, supply-chain compliance shifted from origin management to full-chain due diligence, as multinational customers demand more complete controlled-item and sanctions-screening evidence from Chinese suppliers. For outbound Chinese companies, front-loaded compliance costs, restructured contract clauses and multi-jurisdictional filing coordination have become the most prominent operational variables this week.
focus.source_en: Source: WTO, US BIS, European Commission and major law firm trade-compliance observations · this week

case.title: 本周案例观察：跨境仲裁中“制裁条款”效力争议与不可抗力抗辩的边界
case.summary: 本周一宗涉及中国卖方与欧洲买方的国际货物买卖仲裁引发关注：合同约定适用《联合国国际货物销售合同公约》并含制裁合规条款，卖方因银行冻结货款主张不可抗力解除合同。仲裁庭认为，制裁风险在缔约时已可预见，且合同已设专门合规条款，卖方未证明已采取合理替代措施，故不支持全部免责。启示在于：出海企业不能将制裁与出口管制风险简单归入不可抗力，应在合同中明确合规义务分配、付款路径替代方案及通知期限，并保留尽职调查与减损证据，以降低争议中的举证劣势。
case.source: 来源：国际商会仲裁实践观察与公开裁决要旨 · 本周
case.title_en: Case Watch: Validity of Sanctions Clauses and the Limits of Force Majeure in Cross-Border Arbitration
case.summary_en: An international sale-of-goods arbitration between a Chinese seller and a European buyer drew attention this week. The contract applied the CISG and contained a sanctions-compliance clause; the seller invoked force majeure to terminate after its bank froze payment. The tribunal held that sanctions risk was foreseeable at contracting and that the contract already contained a dedicated compliance clause; the seller failed to prove reasonable alternative measures and thus was not fully exonerated. The lesson: outbound companies should not simply categorise sanctions and export-control risks as force majeure. Contracts should clearly allocate compliance obligations, provide alternative payment routes and notice periods, and preserve due-diligence and mitigation evidence to reduce evidentiary disadvantage in disputes.
case.source_en: Source: ICC arbitration practice observations and published award summaries · this week

policy.title: 本周政策综述：中国涉外法治与粤港澳大湾区跨境便利化举措密集落地
policy.summary: 本周中国涉外与跨境政策延续“制度型开放+风险防控”并重取向。国家层面继续推进外商投资准入负面清单落实与数据跨境流动便利化，强调依法保护外资企业平等参与标准制定与政府采购。粤港澳大湾区方面，跨境理财通、跨境征信合作与港澳律师大湾区执业便利化持续推进，前海、南沙、横琴在跨境争议解决、临时仲裁与港澳调解规则衔接上释放试点信号。对出海企业而言，应关注数据出境安全评估、跨境资金池与境外投资备案（ODI）的协同合规，善用大湾区跨境争议解决与多语种法律服务资源。
policy.source: 来源：中国商务部、国家网信办及粤港澳大湾区相关主管部门公开信息 · 本周
policy.title_en: Policy Roundup: China's Foreign-Related Rule of Law and Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Facilitation Measures
policy.summary_en: This week China's foreign-related and cross-border policies continued to balance institutional opening with risk prevention. At the national level, implementation of the negative list for foreign investment access and facilitation of cross-border data flows were further advanced, with emphasis on protecting foreign-invested enterprises' equal participation in standard-setting and government procurement. In the Greater Bay Area, cross-boundary wealth management, cross-border credit-information cooperation and practice facilitation for Hong Kong and Macao lawyers continued, while Qianhai, Nansha and Hengqin signalled pilots on cross-border dispute resolution, interim arbitration and alignment with Hong Kong and Macao mediation rules. Outbound companies should focus on coordinated compliance for data export security assessments, cross-border cash pools and ODI filing, and leverage GBA cross-border dispute-resolution and multilingual legal resources.
policy.source_en: Source: Public information from China's Ministry of Commerce, Cyberspace Administration and GBA authorities · this week

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：从“被动应对”转向“合规前置”，出海企业需重建合同与证据体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：本周三条主线共同指向一个结论——合规已从交易后端走向交易前端。建议出海企业：第一，建立“客户—物项—目的地—最终用途”四维筛查矩阵，将出口管制与制裁筛查嵌入报价与签约流程；第二，在合同中明确合规义务分配、付款替代路径、制裁触发时的通知与终止机制，避免将合规风险笼统归入不可抗力；第三，针对关税与贸易救济风险，提前准备原产地、成本与供应链证据链，并评估第三国布局的合规穿透风险；第四，善用粤港澳大湾区跨境争议解决与港澳律师协作资源，建立多法域快速响应机制。下周重点关注：美欧涉华出口管制清单更新动向、主要经济体贸易救济立案节奏，以及数据跨境流动细则的落地口径。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师团队本周实务观察 · 本周
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: From Reactive Response to Front-Loaded Compliance — Outbound Companies Must Rebuild Contracts and Evidence Systems
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: This week's three mainlines point to one conclusion — compliance has moved from the back end to the front end of transactions. Outbound companies are advised to: first, build a four-dimensional screening matrix of customer, item, destination and end use, embedding export-control and sanctions screening into quotation and contracting; second, specify in contracts the allocation of compliance obligations, alternative payment routes, and notice and termination mechanisms upon sanctions triggers, rather than broadly categorising compliance risk as force majeure; third, prepare origin, cost and supply-chain evidence chains in advance for tariff and trade-remedy risks, and assess the extraterritorial compliance risks of third-country arrangements; fourth, leverage GBA cross-border dispute-resolution and Hong Kong/Macao lawyer collaboration resources to build a multi-jurisdictional rapid-response mechanism. Next week, watch: updates to US and EU export-control lists concerning China, the pace of trade-remedy filings in major economies, and implementation details of cross-border data-flow rules.
analysis.source_en: Source: Practical observations of Attorney Qin Linhao's team · this week
